WEBSITE INFORMATION

Privacy &
initial inquiries.

Please use this website to start a conversation, not to exchange case files.

Contacting DJ

The inquiry form prepares a draft using your device's email application. This website does not submit or store your form entries on a server. You must send the email from your email app. Your email provider and the recipient's provider handle that message.

Sensitive information

Do not include Social Security numbers, identity documents, applicant records, or sensitive case details in the form or an initial email. Contact DJ to agree on an appropriate exchange method.

External services

This site includes Google Maps and links to public records and independent websites. Those services may receive connection information such as your IP address and operate under their own policies. No marketing analytics have been added to this site.

Engagements

A website inquiry does not establish an investigative engagement. Scope, availability, fees, and working arrangements must be agreed directly with Break Point Investigations.

Questions

Email DJ@brkpnt.co or call 707.332.0604.
